title: New Sgt. Frog TV Anime's 2nd Main Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, 5 New Cast
content:
The staff for Keroro Gunsō ☆ , an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , started streaming the anime's second main trailer, and revealed five new cast members on Monday. The trailer reveals and previews the opening theme song "Kirai nochi Suki!" (From Hate to Love!) by ano , and the ending theme song "Himitsu no Panorama" (Secret Panorama) by PURPLE BUBBLE .

The newly announced cast members are (image above from top left to bottom right):

• Yuki Sakakihara as Fuyuki Hinata

• Minori Fujidera as Natsumi Hinata

• Sumire Morohoshi as Momoka Nishizawa

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Mutsumi Hōjō

• Koko Fukushima as Koyuki Azumaya

The anime will debut on October 3 at 9:30 a.m., and will air on TV Tokyo and its affiliates.

The anime will feature an all-new cast for the franchise . The previous Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! film that opened in June featured a returning cast from previous installments in the anime.

The previously announced new cast includes:

• Kōsuke Echigoya as Sergeant Major Kululu

• Rika Nagae as Private Second Class Tamama

• Makoto Koichi as Sergeant Keroro

• Toshiki Masuda as Corporal Giroro

• Satoshi Inomata as Lance Corporal Dororo

Nobuhiro Kondō ( Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan four seasons, Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens , Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ ) is the chief director of the anime, and Akihiko Sano ( Farmagia , animation director for Medaka Box ) is directing the series at BN Pictures with production cooperation by Bridge and AISLE . Toshimitsu Takeuchi ( Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan four seasons, Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens , Fairy Musketeers ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hatsue Nakayama ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ ) is designing the characters. Kan Sawada ( Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! , Yowamushi Pedal anime franchise ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Color Design: Keiichi Funada

• Art Director: Kenichi Tajiri, Shintarō Inoue

• Director of Photography: Teruyuki Kawase

• Editing: Daisuke Imai

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! (New Sgt. Frog the Movie: The Earth Is in Mortal Peril as Soon as We Come Back!), the new 20th anniversary anime film project for the franchise , opened in Japan on June 26. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend, earning 150,809,200 yen (about US$927,900) in its first three days.

Crunchyroll added the earlier television anime to its catalog beginning in 2021, and it describes the anime:

Keroro is Sergeant Frog - the leader of a platoon of warriors sent to conquer planet Earth. But when the amphibious invaders discovered how much humans enjoy dissecting their comrades, the troops were scattered, the mission was aborted, and Keroro was abandoned. Now, this once proud soldier spends more time wielding a vacuum than he does the weapons of war. It's a far cry from the glory of battle, but hey, at least he's got his own room. And though the invasion may have slowed to a hop, Sergeant Frog still occasionally yearns to overcome his karaoke addiction and reassemble his troops.

Sunrise 's earlier anime series based on Mine Yoshizaki 's Sgt. Frog ( Keroro Gunsō ) manga ran from 2004 to 2011, and it spawned five feature films. Funimation released two "seasons" of the anime on DVD, after ADV Films had licensed but not released the anime.

Discotek licensed the anime, and its release of Sgt. Frog includes all 358 episodes in successive SD Blu-ray Disc volume releases by season, beginning in 2021. Discotek released seasons 5-7 in 2024.

American manga publisher Tokyopop released 20 volumes of the original manga in North America before shutting its doors in 2011.
author: ANN

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Special New Animation by KONAMI Released for Kazuki Takahashi Art Exhibition
content:
A new Yu-Gi-Oh! special animation has been released to commemorate KAZUKI TAKAHASHI: YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS , the first original art exhibition dedicated to series creator Kazuki Takahashi.

The short animation brings Yugi and other familiar characters together in Domino City, with Blue-Eyes White Dragon also appearing alongside Seto Kaiba. Eri Osada directed the animation, with Hiroko Utsumi handling the storyboard. Takahiro Kagami served as character designer and 2D drawing director, while Haruka Taira was art director. KONAMI animation handled the animation production.

ALSO READ: An Interview With the Legendary Kenjiro Tsuda: Yu-Gi-Oh! 25th Anniversary at Anime NYC 2025

The project was created by the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime series production committee as part of celebration for the 30th anniversary of the original manga’s serialization.

KAZUKI TAKAHASHI: YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS will run from December 12, 2026 until February 21, 2027 at Creative Museum Tokyo in Japan. The exhibition will showcase original artwork by Kazuki Takahashi and marks the 30th anniversary of Yu-Gi-Oh! , which began serialization in 1996. It also has an official English information page for international visitors.

Kazuki Takahashi launched Yu-Gi-Oh! in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in 1996, with the manga running until 2004 and being collected in 38 volumes. The series went on to inspire multiple anime adaptations. Takahashi died in 2022 at the age of 60. The story follows Yugi Muto, who solves an ancient Egyptian puzzle known as the Millennium Puzzle, which unleashes the spirit of a mysterious Pharaoh. They then have all kinds of card battles and other games to protect their friends and uncover the mystery behind Pharaoh’s lost memories.

The franchise has since become an iconic trading card game ( Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG/OCG ), multiple anime series (including Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters , GX , 5D’s , ZEXAL , ARC-V , and more), video games, and movies. In related news, a remaster of the anime Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Monsters GX was also recently announced for April 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 New Trailer Previews Opening Theme by THE BEAT GARDEN
content:
The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 has released its second trailer, previewing the opening theme “Escort” by THE BEAT GARDEN ahead of the anime’s October 1, 2026 premiere. The anime will stream weekly exclusively on Netflix. Superfly will perform the Season 2 ending theme “Hanakage.” The Ramparts of Ice , which concluded its first season on July 2, is the second anime adaptation based on Kocha Agasawa’s works, with the first being You and I Are Polar Opposites . Studio KAI is in charge of the animation production, with Mankyu directing the first season and Yasuhiro Nakanishi handling the series composition.

The voice cast includes:

• Anna Nagase as Koyuki Hikawa

• Fuka Izumi as Miki Azumi

• Shoya Chiba as Minato Amamiya

• Satoshi Inomata as Yota Hino

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Tsubasa Igarashi

• Sakura Shinfuku as Tsukiko Shimojima

You can watch the new trailer below.

Several additional projects have also been announced. An exhibition dedicated to Kocha Agasawa’s original The Ramparts of Ice manga will be held in Tokyo from November 28 to December 13, 2026, followed by a second venue at Namba Marui in Osaka from February 6 to 21, 2027. The anime is also collaborating with Priroll on printed sweets featuring scenes of the four main characters.

Check out the key visual for the upcoming season:

The Ramparts of Ice original Japanese web manga initially launched as a digital webtoon before getting serialized on Line Manga, LINE’s digital comics platform. It started on January 10, 2020, and ended after two years on April 28, 2022. MangaPlaza is publishing the manga in English, describing the story: Koyuki Hikawa isn’t great with people and always puts up a wall between others. She had been spending her high school days alone, but one day meets the overly friendly Minato Amamiya. The loner, Koyuki, the popular girl, Miki, the guy with no personal space, Minato, and the laid back member of the basketball team, Yota… The story of these four somewhat awkward students in their bloom of youth begins!
author: Anime Corner

title: Ave Mujica prima aurora Movie Releases Official Trailer
content:
The official trailer for the upcoming Ave Mujica prima aurora movie has been released on Monday. It features a new song from the band titled “A Song of Romance.” The movie is set to premiere on October 16 and the latest song is also now available to stream.

Check out more Ave Mujica: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica x BanG Dream! Our Notes Story Link Trailer Unveiled Doloris from Ave Mujica Covers “A Cruel Angel’s Thesis”

The voice cast of the Ave Mujic a anime includes:

• Kanon Takao as Sakiko Togawa/Oblivionis

• Yuzuki Watase as Mutsumi Wakaba/Mortis

• Rico Sasaki as Uika Misumi/Doloris

• Akane Yonezawa as Nyamu Yutenji/Amoris

• Mei Okada as Umiri Yahata/Timoris

Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast anime debuted in January 2025 and was animated by Sanzigen under the direction of Kodai Kakimoto . A sequel to the TV anime will begin in January 2027. The overall synopsis of the Ave Mujica anime is as follows: “Will you give me the rest of your life?” After losing everything in a single night, Sakiko Togawa reaches out toward an even deeper abyss, one that will drag everyone around her down as well. Gathering the lives of girls burdened with their own troubles and desires, Sakiko raises the curtain on a perfect masquerade. “Welcome to the world of Ave Mujica.” On a stage where sorrow, death, fear, love—even the solace of forgetting—are stripped away, will their masks be torn off and shatter into oblivion, or will they… Source: Bang Dream! title: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 Reveals Third Trailer, Opening and Ending Theme Songs
content:
Ranma 1/2 Season 3 revealed its third trailer, previewing the new opening and ending theme songs ahead of the anime’s return on October 3, 2026. Studio MAPPA is back to handle the animation, with Konosuke Uda returning to direct alongside most of the core staff. The anime will also stream exclusively on Netflix immediately after its TV broadcast.

Fumino will perform the opening theme “Sunao Miman,” while Yuika will perform the ending theme “Kawaikunai.” Both can be heard in the new trailer below.

ALSO READ: MAPPA Shares Exciting Updates for Its Upcoming Projects, Including JUJUTSU KAISEN S4, Chainsaw Man: Assassins Arc, Special MV & More

You can also see the key visual for the new season below.

Kimiko Ueno is back in charge of series composition. The character design is handled by Hiromi Taniguchi, who also serves as chief animation director alongside Yoshiko Saito, Kosuke Kawamura, Riko Kaneda, and Haruki Miura. Kaoru Wada returns to compose the music, while Chihiro Okawa leads the art direction.

The voice cast is all returning and includes:

• Kappei Yamaguchi as Ranma Saotome

• Megumi Hayashibara as Ranma

• Noriko Hidaka as Akane Tendo

• Minami Takayama as Nabiki Tendo

• Kikuko Inoue as Kasumi Tendo

• Akio Otsuka as Soun Tendo

• Cho as Genma Saotome

• Koichi Yamadera as Ryoga Hibiki

• Rei Sakuma as Shampoo

• Toshihiko Seki as Mousse

• Kaori Nazuka as Ukyo Kuonji

• Tomokazu Sugita as Tatewaki Kuno

• Ayane Sakura as Kodachi Kuno

• Kazuhiko Inoue as Happosai

• Ako Mayama as Cologne

• Toshiyuki Morikawa as Tofu Ono

• Mamoru Miyano as Mikado Sanzenin

• Aoi Yuki as Azusa Shiratori

• Akira Ishida as Hikaru Gosunkugi

• Tomokazu Seki as Ichiro

• Kenichi Ogata as Narrator

• Masako Nozawa as Iemoto (Sentaro’s grandmother)

• Jun Fukuyama as Sentaro Daimonji

• Mayumi Tanaka as ???

• Saori Hayami as ???

• Minami Tanaka as Tsubasa Kurenai

Rumiko Takahashi began the Ranma 1/2 manga as her third major series (following URUSEI YATSURA and Maison Ikkoku ) in August 1987. The manga was serialized in Shogakukan’s Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine until March 1996. VIZ Media licensed it in English. Her Mao series also has an ongoing anime adaptation .

The manga was previously adapted into two anime series by Studio Deen: Ranma 1/2 and Ranma 1/2 Nettohen . The two anime together ran for a total of 161 episodes from 1989 to 1992. In addition, the series also got 12 OVAs and three films. A live-action TV special was released in 2011.

The story Ranma and Genma Saotome, a father-son duo who end up falling in a cursed lake and getting cursed. Ranma’s curse has him turning into a girl every time he is splashed with cold water (and reverting when splashed with warm water), while his father turns into a panda under the same conditions. The fact that Ranma is set to marry Akane complicates this further, as she is does not end up liking her fiance at their first meeting.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!' Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, October 5 Debut
content:
Kadokawa unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the television anime of writer Eiko Mutsuhana and illustrator Vient 's Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! ( Dōmo, Sukina Hito ni Horegusuri o Irai Sareta Majo Desu. ) light novel series on Monday. The video reveals more cast and staff members for the anime, the October 5 television and streaming debut, and the anime's theme songs. The video reveals and previews both the anime's opening theme song "Kanawanai" (I Can't Compare) by Centimillimental and the anime's ending theme song "Mada Uso ni wa Naranai" (It's Still Not a Lie) by Rainy.

The anime will debut on AT-X , Tokyo MX , BS NTV , and RKB Mainichi Broadcasting on October 5, and on MBS on October 6. The anime will begin streaming on d Anime Store , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai on October 5, and on other streaming sites on October 10.

The new cast members include:

Hiro Shimono as Tien

Akira Sekine as Villaura

The new staff members include:

• Art Setting: Maho Takahashi

• Art Director: Scott MacDonald

• Color Setting: Yuki Hayashi

• CG Director: Yudai Takahashi

• Director of Photography: Hiroaki Asano

• Editor: Toshihiko Kojima

• Music Producer: Shigeru Saitō

Mikako Komatsu voices Rose, and Yōhei Azakami voices Harij.

Keizō Kusakawa is directing the anime at diomedéa . Wataru Watari is overseeing the series scripts, and Masakazu Ishikawa is designing the characters. Yayoi Tateishi is directing the sound, and Hayato Matsumura is composing the music with Heart Company producing the music.

Cross Infinite World releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections! Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day…to feed her?

This is the heartwarming story of a shut-in witch and an arrogant, straitlaced knight whose romance starts from a love potion.

Mutsuhana began serializing the novel on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in April 2019, and the series ended in March 2020. Futabasha began publishing the story in print with art by Vient in October 2019. Futabasha published the second volume in March 2020.

Kamada 's manga adaptation runs on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker website, and Kadokawa published the sixth manga volume on February 5. Yen Press releases the manga under the English title Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion . Yen Press released the manga's fifth volume on January 20.
author: ANN

Akira Sekine as Villaura
The new staff members include:
Art Setting: Maho Takahashi
Art Director: Scott MacDonald
Color Setting: Yuki Hayashi
CG Director: Yudai Takahashi
Director of Photography: Hiroaki Asano
Editor: Toshihiko Kojima
Music Producer: Shigeru Saitō
Mikako Komatsu voices Rose, and Yōhei Azakami voices Harij.

Keizō Kusakawa is directing the anime at diomedéa . Wataru Watari is overseeing the series scripts, and Masakazu Ishikawa is designing the characters. Yayoi Tateishi is directing the sound, and Hayato Matsumura is composing the music with Heart Company producing the music.
Cross Infinite World releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections! Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day…to feed her?
This is the heartwarming story of a shut-in witch and an arrogant, straitlaced knight whose romance starts from a love potion.

Mutsuhana began serializing the novel on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in April 2019, and the series ended in March 2020. Futabasha began publishing the story in print with art by Vient in October 2019. Futabasha published the second volume in March 2020.

Kamada 's manga adaptation runs on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker website, and Kadokawa published the sixth manga volume on February 5. Yen Press releases the manga under the English title Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion . Yen Press released the manga's fifth volume on January 20.

title: Fate/Extra Record Game Reveals Character Video for Caster
content:
Aniplex revealed a new character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Monday. The video features the character Caster, voiced by Chiwa Saitō .

Chiwa Saitō as Caster

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam on January 28, following several delays. Marvelous Europe will publish the game in Europe and Australia.

The game will get a physical Limited Edition that includes a 3-disc soundtrack, SteelBook case, and artbook. The Digital Deluxe Edition will include an arranged BGM pack, Servant and player outfits bundle, three outfit packs, a digital soundtrack, and artbook.

The game was slated for a release in spring this year after a previous delay from a 2025 release. Type-Moon studio BB announced the game in July 2020, in what was the 10th anniversary of the original Fate/Extra game.

Aniplex will now publish the game.

The game had been delayed indefinitely following a mutual agreement between Notes (the Type-Moon creative circle's official corporate and publishing name) and Bandai Namco Entertainment for the latter to pull out of publishing of the game. Type-Moon noted then that development on the game would continue, but the game's development structure would change.

The game's director and planner, and Type-Moon studio BB director Kazuya Nino left Type-Moon studio BB, due to personal reasons, and has also stepped down as Fate/Extra Record game's director and planner. Nino added that he will be taking a break from developing games due to current health concerns. Nino was the producer for Fate/Extra , and also worked on the first Etrian Odyssey game.

Arco Wada returns as the game's character designer.

Marvelous Entertainment and Type-Moon released the Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game in Japan in 2010. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2011. The Fate/Extra CCC companion game shipped in Japan on the PSP in March 2013. The games are set in an alternate science-fiction continuity of Type-Moon 's Fate universe, often referred to by fans as the "Extraverse."

The games inspired SHAFT 's 10-episode television anime Fate/Extra Last Encore in January 2018. Netflix began streaming the anime outside of Japan in June 2018. The three-episode Fate/Extra Last Encore: Illustrias Tendōsetsu (Illustrias Geocentrism) special then debuted in July 2018.

Marvelous released Fate/EXTELLA: The Umbral Star , an "Extraverse" game, for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in November 2016. XSEED Games released the game in the West in January 2017, and on PC and Switch in July 2017. Fate/EXTELLA LINK , an enhanced version of the game, shipped in Japan in June 2018, and XSEED Games released the game in March 2019.

Koei Tecmo launched the action RPG Fate/Samurai Remnant in September 2023. The game is available worldwide for PS5, PS4, PC via Steam , and Switch.

title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love Manga Ends with 7th Volume
content:
Kadokawa is listing the seventh compiled book volume of Momose Hanada 's manga adaptation of Harunadon 's Even a Replica Can Fall in Love ( Replica Datte, Koi o Suru ) novel series as its final volume. Kadokawa will ship the final volume on October 27.

Yen Press publishes the manga physically in English, and Kadokawa 's BookWalker service releases the manga digitally. Yen Press describes the manga:

When she doesn't feel well, when there's a test, when she doesn't want to go to school…I take her place. I'm Sunao Aikawa's replica, and I exist solely for her sake. Or, at least, that's how it was until he came into my life. Now, I wear my hair up so he can tell us apart, and we make promises for a tomorrow I may not have. Everything about me might be borrowed―but my heart is mine alone.

Hanada has been serializing the manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine since April 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's sixth volume on May 27.

The original story by Harunadon won the grand prize in the 29th Dengeki Novel Prize in 2022. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint began publishing the novel series in February 2023, and the sixth volume shipped on April 10. Yen Press also publishes the novel series in English.

The novel series inspired a television anime adaptation that debuted on April 7.
author: ANN

title: You and I are Polar Opposites 2nd Season Anime's 12th Episode Airs on September 27
content:
Animation studio Lapin Track announced on Sunday that the 24th episode of the You and I Are Polar Opposites ( Seihantaina Kimi to Boku ) anime (the 12th episode of the show's second season) will air on September 27, and the show is taking a break next week.

The second season anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's romantic comedy manga debuted on July 5 on MBS and TBS and 26 other networks on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST. Crunchyroll streams the new season and also streams an English dub .

MANGA Plus published the manga series in English and describes the story:

Suzuki, an energetic girl who can't help but follow the crowd, finds herself drawn to Tani, a quiet boy who can easily speak his mind. Enter: the serialization of a hit one-shot! A story for anyone who wants to enjoy love! This down-to-earth, relatable rom-com is ready to pull at your heartstrings!

Takakazu Nagatomo is directing the anime at Lapin Track . Teruko Utsumi ( Sarazanmai ) is writing the scripts and is also serving as animation producer. Mako Miyako is designing the characters. Naho Kozono ( Golden Kamuy ) is the sub-character designer, and is also the chief animation director, along with Sayuri Sakimoto ( Orient ). The musician tofubeats is composing the music.

Artist 7co (read as Nanako) performs the opening theme song "Nekojarashi," and Mega Shinnosuke performs the ending theme song "Unmei no Kimi" ("You are the one").

The anime's first season debuted on January 11 on MBS , TBS , and their affiliates, and aired on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST. The series streamed on ABEMA in Japan at 5:30 p.m. JST on Sundays. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and also streamed a same-day English dub . The series also streamed in partnership with Animax Broadcasting Korea and Medialink.

Agasawa launched the manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform in May 2022. The manga originally launched as a one-shot on the website in January 2021. The manga ended in November 2024. Shueisha shipped the eighth and final compiled book volume in March 2025.

Viz Media also publishes the series in English.

The series has over 1.8 million copies in circulation (including digital copies). The manga ranked #3 in the 16th Manga Taisho Awards in 2023, and #7 in the 17th Manga Taisho Awards in 2024.

title: Gundam RG XARX-ZERO Anime 'Launches' in N. America, Japan in April 2027
content:
The official website for the Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO anime revealed on Monday that the anime will "launch" in North America and Japan in April 2027. The anime's Japanese website uses the term "hōsō" (broadcast) that is often used for airing on television.

Kenji Kamiyama ( Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Star Wars: Visions ' "The Ninth Jedi", Eden of the East ) is directing the anime at Sola Animation . Toh Enjoe ( The Ghost in the Shell 2026, Godzilla Singular Point , The Empire of Corpses ) is collaborating on the world-building in the anime's science fiction setting.

The Gundam RG XARX-ZERO anime is part of the larger RG Project, "a next-generation Gundam initiative that expands the franchise into a new universe." The previously announced Gundam Rogue Orbit game is also headlining the project, although the game's story is set 90 years after the Gundam RG XARX-ZERO anime. (The "RG Project" is not to be confused with "Real Grade," an advanced level of model kits that Bandai sells for the overall Gundam franchise .) Kamiyama teased at San Diego Comic-Con that there are elements in the project besides the anime and the game. The Gundam Rogue Orbit game will debut in March 2027.

Takeo Ōtsuka voices Ray Azumi, "the permanently assigned pilot of the Gundam Zero and war orphan who lost his parents in an Apocalypse attack."

Eiichi Shimizu ( Linebarrels of Iron ), who created the 2011 Ultraman manga (which Kamiyama adapted into several anime), is designing the Gundam units. STATO drafted the original character designs, and Miyako Takasu is adapting those designs for the animation's character designs and is serving as chief animation director. Gō Shiina ( Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , God Eater , Tales of Zestiria game) is composing the music. Joseph Chou and Yasufumi Kobashi producing.
author: ANN
